description_en: Retrieves the details of a cache refresh task
description_zh: 获取缓存刷新任务详情
name: DescribeIspFlushCacheTask

parameters.help_en: The language of the returned information. Valid values: zh for Chinese and en for English
parameters.help_zh: 返回信息的语言，zh 为中文，en 为英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cache refresh task to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的缓存刷新任务 ID
parameters.name: task_id

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the task was created. The time is displayed in UTC in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format
CreateTime.description_zh: 任务创建时间，使用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp of the task creation time in milliseconds
CreateTimestamp.description_zh: 任务创建时间的毫秒时间戳

DomainName.description_en: The domain name refreshed by the task

FlushCacheResults.description_en: The list of cache refresh results returned by region
FlushCacheResults.description_zh: 按地区返回的缓存刷新结果列表

items.description_en: The cache refresh result for a single region
items.description_zh: 单个地区的缓存刷新结果

DnsNodes.description_en: The list of DNS node refresh results in the region
DnsNodes.description_zh: 该地区的 DNS 节点刷新结果列表

items.description_en: The refresh result of a single DNS node
items.description_zh: 单个 DNS 节点的刷新结果

Answers.description_en: The list of DNS records returned by the DNS node
Answers.description_zh: 该 DNS 节点返回的解析记录列表

items.description_zh: 单条 DNS 解析记录

Name.description_en: The domain name of the DNS record

Record.description_en: The value of the DNS record

Ttl.description_en: The TTL of the DNS record, in seconds
Ttl.description_zh: 解析记录的 TTL，单位为秒

Type.description_en: The type of the DNS record, such as an A record
Type.description_zh: 解析记录类型，例如 A 记录

NodeIp.description_en: The IP address of the DNS node
NodeIp.description_zh: DNS 节点的 IP 地址

SpName.description_en: The name of the ISP to which the DNS node belongs
SpName.description_zh: DNS 节点所属运营商名称

Status.description_en: The cache refresh status of the DNS node
Status.description_zh: DNS 节点的缓存刷新状态

Province.description_en: The province to which the DNS node belongs

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the cache refresh instance to which the task belongs
InstanceId.description_zh: 任务所属的缓存刷新实例 ID

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the cache refresh instance to which the task belongs
InstanceName.description_zh: 任务所属的缓存刷新实例名称

Isp.description_en: The ISP refreshed by the task. TELECOM indicates China Telecom
Isp.description_zh: 任务刷新的运营商，TELECOM 表示电信

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the cache refresh task

TaskStatus.description_en: The status of the task. Valid values: EXECUTING, SUCCESSFUL, and FAILED
TaskStatus.description_zh: 任务状态：EXECUTING 为执行中，SUCCESSFUL 为成功，FAILED 为失败
